descriptionText:
Business Development Associate — Quantitative Signal Sales | Institutional B2B | Remote | Commission-Based


The Opportunity
AirQuant is seeking 1–2 Business Development Associates to help us establish commercial relationships with large-scale quantitative institutions. Our product is a suite of rigorously validated, non-arbitrage alpha signals applicable across all major asset classes — it's ready, and we need experienced connectors who can open the right doors.


This is not a retail or wealth management role. The ideal candidate already operates within or alongside the institutional quantitative ecosystem.


About AirQuant
AirQuant is a quantitative research team from the University of Melbourne, the University of Chicago, Columbia University, NTU, and NTHU. We license high-quality, non-arbitrage quantitative signals across equities, futures, cryptocurrencies, derivatives, and other priceable asset classes to institutional clients, earning a share of generated profit as a signal fee. We are currently in an active business development phase with ongoing institutional discussions underway.


Role Overview
Your mandate is to identify and introduce AirQuant to quantitative institutions — quant hedge funds, systematic asset managers, proprietary trading firms, and other signal-consuming buy-side entities — who are looking to source external alpha at scale. You will work independently, supported by pitch materials and signal performance documentation.
This is a commission-only, fully remote, independent contractor engagement.


Key Responsibilities

- Identify large-scale quantitative institutions with the AUM capacity and operational infrastructure to deploy external signals.
- Leverage existing relationships or conduct targeted outreach to initiate introductions at the relevant decision-making level (CIO, Head of Quant Research, Portfolio Management).
- Represent AirQuant's signal offering professionally and accurately in introductory meetings.
- Support commercial negotiations through to a signed signal licensing agreement.


Commission Structure
We offer a performance-driven commission model designed to reward exceptional client acquisition. 


Upon successfully onboarding an institutional client, the associate earns a commission calculated as a percentage of the firm's signal revenue attributable to that client — 


Commission = AUM × Target Annual Return × Commission Period × Firm Profit Share Rate × Your Commission Rate


As a benchmark, a client allocating $100M based on historical model performance, over a two-year commission window at our standard 25% profit-sharing arrangement, generates $15M in firm revenue — of which the originating associate receives their agreed share. 


Commissions are paid periodically over the duration of the commission window, aligning your long-term incentives with client retention and satisfaction.


Who We're Looking For

- Demonstrated experience in institutional B2B business development, with a track record of engaging quantitative funds, systematic hedge funds, or institutional buy-side firms.
- An existing professional network within the quantitative or systematic trading ecosystem — connections at the CIO, Head of Research, or senior portfolio management level are strongly preferred.
- Ability to credibly represent a quantitative signal product in technical conversations.

title: Senior User Experience Researcher
descriptionText:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi At a Glance



- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021
- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide
- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About The Team

UX Research at Angi is embedded in a multidisciplinary team of designers, researchers, and content creators. We build experiences that span both sides of a two-sided marketplace — homeowners navigating big decisions and service professionals growing their businesses — across digital and in-person touchpoints.

We're in a meaningful growth period. This isn't a role focused solely on optimizing existing flows. We're building new product surfaces, exploring new experience models, and using research to identify opportunities we haven't yet named. If you're energized by working in ambiguous, early-stage problem spaces and helping a team build from a strong point of view, this is a good team for you.

About The Role

This is a rare opportunity to do two kinds of research that most roles force you to choose between.

On one side, you'll co-define and execute blue sky and strategic discovery work alongside research leadership — exploring future-state opportunities, emerging user needs, and experience spaces that don't have a roadmap item yet. This is generative, open-ended work where the question is often as important as the answer, and where your instincts about what's worth exploring will matter as much as your ability to run a clean study.

On the other side, you'll own a portfolio of customer experience metrics programs — tracking how users feel and behave across key moments in the Angi journey, measuring the impact of product changes over time, and building the longitudinal understanding that keeps the team grounded in what's actually happening for customers.

Together, these two workstreams give you something unusual: real influence at the front edge of product strategy, and the satisfaction of watching your research drive decisions you can measure. You'll report directly to the VP of Research — which means a short path to the conversations that matter and a genuine opportunity to shape how the research function evolves.

What You'll Do



- Independently scope and execute research studies based on product decisions and risks — choosing methods that balance rigor and speed, and adjusting when conditions change
- Work across multiple data sources: qualitative interviews, usability sessions, concept tests, lightweight surveys, and secondary research
- Participate in and support generative and discovery research — concept testing, opportunity framing, early-stage exploration — where the question isn't fully defined yet
-  Synthesize across sessions to identify root causes and motivations, not just surface-level patterns; produce insights grounded in repeated behavior, context, and meaning
- Connect insights to near-term roadmap decisions and help partners understand user tradeoffs alongside business constraints
- Communicate findings clearly to product, design, and engineering partners — distilling complexity into what matters most and what to do about it
- Present to cross-functional partners and occasional director-level stakeholders with confidence and clarity
- Use AI tools to accelerate synthesis and research operations (tagging, clustering, transcription, repository management) while validating outputs for accuracy
- Contribute to team practice: share reusable frameworks, improve templates, mentor junior researchers on craft and process
- Build trusted relationships with product and design partners within your zone

Who You Are



- 4–6 years of UX research experience, with a combination of consultancy/innovation firm experience and in-house product work
- Your consultancy or design firm experience gave you: comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 spaces; a habit of working with stakeholders who aren't sure what they need; and confidence forming and defending a point of view with limited data
- Your in-house product experience gave you: familiarity with how product roadmaps, sprint cycles, and metrics work; an understanding of how research earns trust and gets used in a fast-moving team; and a track record of insights that influenced real decisions
- Skilled in qualitative methods (interviews, diary studies, concept testing, usability testing) with growing comfort in quantitative approaches (surveys, behavioral data analysis, A/B interpretation)
- You scope studies independently and choose methods that fit the question — not the other way around
- You synthesize across sessions to find root causes, not just recurring quotes; your insights say something about why, not just what
- Strong, clear communicator — you can write a sharp one-pager, structure a crisp readout, and present to a skeptical PM or design lead without losing them
- Collaborative and reliable — partners know what to expect from you, you manage expectations proactively, and you raise blockers early
- Curious about home ownership, home improvement, and what it means to help people find reliable help for something as personal as where they live
- Comfortable working in AI-assisted workflows and interested in doing research on AI-powered product experiences as we build them

Compensation & Benefits



- The base salary band for this position ranges from $130,000 - $180,000, commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location.
- This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package
- Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs
- Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it
- Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K)
- The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

descriptionText:
About the Role
We are seeking an exceptional Lead Researcher to lead and scale a world-class AI research organization focused on advancing the state of the art in machine learning, large language models, and applied AI systems. This role is both strategic and hands-on, responsible for defining long-term research vision while actively contributing to breakthrough innovations that directly impact product and business outcomes.
As Head of Research, you will build, mentor, and manage a high-caliber team of researchers and research engineers, partner closely with executive leadership, and translate cutting-edge research into scalable, real-world systems.
Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the research vision and roadmap, aligned with company strategy and long-term goals
- Lead and grow a team of AI Researchers, Applied Scientists, and Research Engineers
- Drive innovation across areas such as:
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Reasoning and planning systems
- Representation learning
- Robustness, safety, and evaluation
- Multimodal and agent-based systems
- Balance long-horizon exploratory research with near-term applied research that powers products
- Ensure research excellence through strong scientific rigor, reproducibility, and evaluation standards
- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to transition research into production
- Represent the company externally through publications, conferences, and industry engagement
- Establish best practices for research processes, tooling, and infrastructure
- Mentor senior researchers and develop future research leaders
Required Qualifications

- PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a closely related field (or equivalent research experience)
- 0-7 years of experience in AI/ML research, with at least several years in a research role
- Proven track record of high-impact research contributions (top-tier conferences, journals, or widely adopted systems)
- Deep expertise in modern ML techniques, especially LLMs, deep learning, and foundation models
- Experience leading and scaling research teams in industry or advanced research labs
- Strong understanding of the tradeoffs between research innovation and production constraints
- Ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading research at a top AI lab, FAANG company, or well-known AI startup
- Publications at leading venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP)
- Experience with model training at scale, including distributed systems and ML infrastructure
- Background in deploying research models into real-world products
- Prior experience influencing company-level technical strategy
What We Offer

- Base salary up to $500,000, plus competitive equity
- Opportunity to shape the future direction of cutting-edge AI research
- Access to significant compute and research resources
- Collaboration with elite engineers, researchers, and product leaders
- A culture that values deep thinking, experimentation, and long-term impact

title: (Remote) VP, Research & Development
descriptionText:
Amazing Charts, a division of Harris; is seeking a Vice President of Research & Development who will lead the R&D organization for the business unit.

This role is responsible for setting the technical and delivery strategy for a mature, mission critical healthcare platform while guiding its evolution toward modern architecture, improved delivery predictability, and long term sustainability.

The VP of R&D will operate within an established product, team, and customer base, making informed decisions under real constraints. The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency, strategic thinking, financial acumen, and experience applying AI in practical, business driven ways. While not expected to write code, this leader must be able to engage deeply on architecture, delivery approach, risk, and tradeoffs.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 10%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

Salary

120K - 135K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What Your Impact Will Be



- Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary R&D organization including Engineering, Quality Assurance, and delivery teams.
- Translate business strategy and product priorities into executable technical road maps.
- Provide architectural and technical leadership across the product portfolio.
- Own delivery outcomes including predictability, quality, and platform stability.
- Own the R&D budget including forecasting, cost management, and financial tradeoffs.
- Evaluate and govern the use of AI enabled technologies across development and operations.

What Success Looks Like In This Role



- Establish predictable delivery and accountability.
- Improve platform stability and regulatory readiness.
- Introduce thoughtful modernization aligned with business value.
- Act as a trusted executive partner on technology, investment, and risk.

What We Are Looking For



- 10+ years of leadership experience in software development or technology organizations.
- 7+ years of experience with cloud platforms, APIs, and modern architecture.
- 5+ years of strong technical foundation in development (working as a developer).
- 5+ years of experience working with R&D budgets and financial outcomes.
- 5+ years' experience implementing best market practice, modern processes and workflow within development teams.
- 1+ years demonstrated experience evaluating, adopting, and governing AI enabled technologies.
- 1+ years of experience leading SaaS product development and operations.
- 1+ years of experience applying AI to improve productivity, delivery efficiency, or decision making.
- 1+ years of experience assessing AI related tradeoffs including cost, risk, data quality, security, and compliance.
- Proven ability to lead through ambiguity.
- Strong executive communication.
- Ability to understand, navigate, and make effective decisions in business situations to drive results.
- Able to create strong relationships and gain trust within your team.
- A strategic and business-focused mindset with the ability to turn complex data into compelling narratives and actionable business insights.
- Stakeholder management.

What Would Make You Stand Out



- Experience working in development with Microsoft technologies (.net, SQL, Visual Basic).
- Experience working with Jira for tracking purposes.
- Knowledge in AI development and implementation (certifications is nice to have).
- Experience working with React in the front end.
- Knowledge working in technology Integrations (third party and clients).

What We Can Offer



- 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
- Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
- Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
- Lifestyle rewards
- Remote work and more!

About Amazing Charts

Amazing Charts, founded in 2001 by a practicing family physician, offers user-friendly and affordable Electronic Health Record (EHR) solutions tailored for small to medium-sized medical practices. Acquired by Harris Healthcare in 2017, the company provides a comprehensive suite of services, including Practice Management, Medical Billing, Population Health, and Patient Engagement tools, all designed to enhance clinical efficiency and patient care. Learn more at: amazingcharts.com

About Harris

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

title: Director of Quantitative Research
descriptionText:
Hillsdale Investment Management Inc. (Hillsdale) is an independent, employee-driven, and client-aligned investment boutique managing assets on behalf of a select group of sophisticated institutional and private wealth investors. We engage in disciplined active investment management, specializing in equities, alternatives, ESG, and customized mandates. We are committed to producing the highest quality equity investment strategies. As a firm, we value curiosity, humility, resilience, and strive to maintain an open, collegial and dynamic work environment. Hillsdale is recognized for both investment and service excellence – a reflection of our relentless pursuit of research and development and the dedication of our employees who invest alongside our clients.


Hillsdale has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for our industry and across Canada.


We have a new opportunity for a Director of Quantitative Research to join our Portfolio Management team. Reporting to the Head of Research, you will:

- Play a key role in the firm’s quantitative research agenda in alpha generation, portfolio construction, and risk modelling.
- Oversee the research, validation, and deployment of stock-selection models using advanced statistical techniques.
- Guide and mentor a team of research analysts to conduct alpha research across multiple regions and investment universes leveraging our proprietary research engines.
- Broaden our research capabilities in pursuit of new datasets, economically motivated factors, and innovative analytics to improve our research breadth.
- Lead the architecture and continuous improvement of our quantitative research platform, partnering with engineering to translate research needs into production-ready systems.
- Collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement changes in our production and research environments.
- Foster strategic adoption of emerging capabilities in Machine Learning or Large Language Models to enhance our research signals and analysis.
- Refine research best practices, documentation, and standards to ensure that our research adheres to the highest standards.
- Present research recommendations and portfolio analysis to internal and external stakeholders.


WHAT WILL YOU BRING? 

- An intellectually curious mind with a drive to uncover novel investment insights.
- 10+ years of experience in quantitative investing, with prior experience leading equity research.
- Ph.D. or master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Statistics, Finance, etc.)
- Expertise in alpha research, factor modelling, or machine learning applied to financial markets.
- Demonstrated research or technical creativity.
- Programming skills, especially in Python.
- Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills with an emphasis on strong presentation skills.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize tasks and deliver on agreed timelines.


Nice to Have (preferred but not required)

- Quantitative research experience in other domains.
- Appreciation of financial data, workflow, and systems architecture.
- CFA or related designation.
- Other programming knowledge a plus: R, Polars, Java, MATLAB, C/C++, etc.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? 

- Opportunity to be a key leader in the firm’s quantitative research initiatives and shape our research platform.
- Ability to work in a nimble, agile environment.
- Competitive compensation package.
- Employer-funded professional development, including courses and conferences.
- Flexible work environment and commuting reimbursement when you do work from the office.
- Supportive amenities and initiatives: access to a fully stocked kitchen, catered lunches, ergonomic home office setup, employee appreciation events, and retreats.
- Centrally located office at King and Bay with remarkable views of Toronto and Lake Ontario.
- Please note that relocation to Toronto is not required. However, the successful candidate must be available to travel to Toronto once per month for a minimum of 3 consecutive business days.


Additional Information:
This job advertisement is a current vacancy for a new opportunity. Hillsdale may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and assessing applicants. The use of AI does not replace human decision making.


Hillsdale is an equal opportunity employer and as such does not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origins, age, sexual orientation, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We encourage applications from people of all abilities and will make reasonable accommodations upon request.

title: Head of Research
descriptionText:
About the Firm
We are a privately held investment research and trading firm managing approximately $500M across public markets, alternative investments, and private opportunities.


Our team is intentionally small, highly experienced, and performance-driven. We operate in a fast-paced environment where independent thinking, intellectual rigor, and sound judgment are highly valued. We seek individuals who thrive in ambiguity, challenge conventional wisdom, and possess a relentless drive to uncover differentiated insights.


The Opportunity
We are seeking a senior investment research leader to become a key strategic partner to the firm's leadership team.


This individual will play a critical role in shaping the firm's investment perspective by identifying emerging opportunities, evaluating risks, and building scalable research processes that create a sustainable information advantage.


The successful candidate will combine deep analytical capabilities with strong leadership skills and a demonstrated ability to generate original investment insights across a broad range of markets and industries.


Key Responsibilities


Research Leadership

- Build and lead a high-performing investment research function.
- Develop and oversee teams responsible for market intelligence, research, and opportunity identification.
- Establish processes and frameworks that improve the quality and speed of investment decision-making.
- Foster a culture of intellectual curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Investment Research & Intelligence

- Monitor global markets, industries, technologies, and geopolitical developments.
- Identify emerging themes, structural shifts, and inflection points before they become widely recognized.
- Separate meaningful signals from market noise and synthesize complex information into actionable insights.
- Evaluate investment opportunities across public and private markets.
Strategic Analysis

- Develop independent views on macroeconomic trends, industry developments, technological innovation, and competitive dynamics.
- Analyze incentives, second-order effects, and hidden dependencies that may influence investment outcomes.
- Build frameworks that improve opportunity identification and risk assessment.
- Maintain a forward-looking perspective on key market narratives and investment themes.
Partnership with Leadership

- Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership.
- Translate research findings into clear investment recommendations and strategic guidance.
- Collaborate closely on portfolio positioning, thematic research, and long-term investment priorities.
- Help shape the firm's overall investment worldview and decision-making process.


Ideal Background
We are interested in candidates who have demonstrated excellence in one or more of the following environments:

- Hedge Funds
- Family Offices
- Investment Management Firms
- Global Macro Funds
- Alternative Asset Managers
- Private Investment Firms
- Strategic Research and Intelligence Organizations


Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in investment research, investing, strategy, or related disciplines.
- Demonstrated ability to generate differentiated investment insights.
- Experience evaluating opportunities across multiple sectors, asset classes, or geographies.
- Strong understanding of macroeconomics, financial markets, business models, and competitive dynamics.
- Experience leading teams and building research capabilities.
- Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to make sound decisions in environments with incomplete information.
- High degree of intellectual curiosity, ownership, and independent judgment.


Preferred Characteristics

- First-principles thinker.
- Naturally skeptical and evidence-driven.
- Strong pattern recognition and synthesis capabilities.
- Comfortable navigating complex and rapidly evolving information environments.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action.
- Capable of influencing investment decisions through insight rather than authority.


Compensation
Competitive compensation package including base salary, performance incentives, and long-term upside participation. Total compensation will be commensurate with experience, track record, and impact.

title: VP - Research
descriptionText:
Emerald Research Group 

Emerald is a modern research consultancy that helps companies solve their stickiest problems with approaches that are creative, custom, and consultative. We aren’t your average researchers – with an eye for innovation, we’re always pushing the boundaries of the possible, blending the newest methods with the practical knowledge of how things get done to make a big impact.

A Little More About Us



-  We Look to the Future: We believe the future of research is integrated – bringing qual, quant, behaviors, and analytics together – and we’re actively investing in creative ways to create these holistic views. 
-  We Go Deep: Every project we take on is fully custom, allowing us to immerse ourselves in businesses’ problems to uncover the best solutions – and we’ll never deliver a data dump. 
-  We Move with Businesses: Emerald was created to close the gaps left by traditional research agencies, so we consult with businesses to truly become their strategic partners from start to finish. 
-  We’re All in This Together: We care deeply about our people and value everyone’s opinion, no matter their position. Whether you’re an executive or an intern, you’re part of our Emerald family 

What We’re Looking For

Emerald Research Group is seeking a Vice President to lead and grow a portfolio of Consumer & Productivity / Cloud & Industry clients while shaping the future of our research, consulting, and client experience capabilities. This role combines strategic client leadership, business growth, organizational leadership, and research innovation to drive meaningful impact for both clients and Emerald.

The VP serves as a senior strategic advisor to executive client stakeholders and is responsible for developing long-term partnerships, expanding business opportunities, and ensuring excellence across complex qualitative, quantitative, and behavioral research engagements. This leader will oversee and develop high-performing teams, contribute to organizational strategy, and help evolve Emerald’s methodologies, operations, and market positioning.

This role is ideal for a research and insights leader who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and is energized by building teams, growing client relationships, and driving innovation in customer understanding in the cloud and enterprise technology sector.

What You’ll Do

Client & Business Leadership



-  Own and grow a portfolio of technology sector client relationships, ensuring long-term partnership success, client satisfaction, and revenue growth. 
-  Serve as a trusted advisor to senior and executive-level client stakeholders, bringing strategic perspective beyond individual research engagements. 
-  Identify and drive new business opportunities, account expansion strategies, and cross-functional partnerships that contribute to Emerald’s growth objectives. 
-  Lead complex client engagements across qualitative, quantitative, and behavioral research methodologies, ensuring high-impact outcomes and exceptional client experiences. 
-  Partner with senior leadership on business planning, forecasting, revenue management, and strategic growth initiatives. 
-  Represent Emerald externally through thought leadership, industry engagement, and strategic client-facing opportunities. 

Research & Practice Leadership



-  Set and evolve standards for research quality, innovation, storytelling, and client delivery across teams and accounts. 
-  Guide the development of new methodologies, tools, operational processes, and service offerings that strengthen Emerald’s market position and capabilities. 
-  Demonstrate deep proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to guide clients, teams, and leadership through all phases of research design, execution, and analysis. 
-  Identify, evaluate, and advocate for emerging AI methodologies and tools that drive operational efficiency, accelerate time to insight, and support revenue optimization across Emerald. 
-  Oversee strategic research design and ensure teams deliver actionable insights that influence business, product, marketing, and go-to-market decisions. 
-  Champion advanced storytelling and data visualization approaches that translate complex findings into compelling business narratives. 
-  Evaluate emerging trends, technologies, vendors, and market opportunities to continuously strengthen Emerald’s offerings and operational effectiveness. 

Organizational and Team Leadership



-  Play a key leadership role in shaping Emerald's culture, driving standards of quality, strategic thinking, and professional excellence across the organization 
-  Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing research leaders and teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and growth. 
-  Build organizational capability through leadership development, coaching, knowledge sharing, and scalable team processes. 
-  Drive operational excellence across teams, including resource planning, delivery quality, process optimization, and financial performance. 
-  Partner cross-functionally with leadership teams to shape organizational priorities, improve ways of working, and support long-term business objectives. 
-  Contribute to the development of company policies, talent strategies, and organizational standards that support Emerald’s continued growth and culture. 

Who You Are



-  A Strategic Research Leader: You bring deep expertise across qualitative, quantitative, and behavioral research, with experience leading complex engagements and high-performing teams. You stay current on emerging methods and know how to turn innovation into scalable client impact. 
-  A Trusted Executive Advisor: Clients see you as a credible partner who understands their business and industry. You lead executive conversations with confidence and deliver insights that shape strategic decisions. 
-  A Business & Growth Leader: You think beyond individual projects to the health of the broader account portfolio. You help grow client relationships, identify new opportunities, and balance client needs with commercial outcomes. 
-  A Clear Storyteller: You translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives for executive audiences. You distill insights into actionable recommendations through strong storytelling and presentation skills. 
-  A Calm Operator: You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity under pressure. You balance rigor with agility while maintaining high standards for quality and delivery. 
-  An Organizational Leader: You lead through mentorship and influence, developing talent and strengthening team capability. You help create an environment where people can grow and do their best work. 
-  A Technology Enthusiast: You are curious about cloud and enterprise technology and comfortable engaging in conversations across modern platforms, infrastructure, and the evolving tech landscape. 

Must Haves (Requirements)



-  8+ years of experience in market research, insights, consulting, or related strategic research environments. 
-  Demonstrated success leading large-scale client relationships, business growth initiatives, and high-performing teams. 
-  Deep expertise across qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, insight development, and strategic storytelling. 
-  Strong understanding of cloud, enterprise technology, digital transformation, or related industry ecosystems. 
-  Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. 
-  Experience managing complex business portfolios, revenue targets, and organizational initiatives. 
-  Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive operational and strategic outcomes. 
-  Passion for mentorship, innovation, and building collaborative team cultures. 

Other Important Information

While Emerald empowers a fully remote workforce, its team members are a close-knit group of researchers who appreciate the opportunity to collaborate in-person on a quarterly basis.

Emerald equips all employees with the technology and tools to be most productive while working remote.

Just as we invest in our clients, we also invest in our people. Though we have the energy and feel of a startup, we offer full benefits as part of the Stagwell Group, the largest independent data driven digital marketing services firm in the U.S.

title: (Remote) VP, Research & Development

The VP of R&D will operate within an established product, team, and customer base, making informed decisions under real constraints. The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency, strategic thinking, financial acumen, and experience applying AI in practical, business driven ways. While not expected to write code, this leader must be able to engage deeply on architecture, delivery approach, risk, and tradeoffs.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 10%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

Salary

120K - 135K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

- Establish predictable delivery and accountability.

- Introduce thoughtful modernization aligned with business value.
- Act as a trusted executive partner on technology, investment, and risk.

- 10+ years of leadership experience in software development or technology organizations.
- 7+ years of experience with cloud platforms, APIs, and modern architecture.
- 5+ years of strong technical foundation in development (working as a developer).
- 5+ years of experience working with R&D budgets and financial outcomes.
- 5+ years' experience implementing best market practice, modern processes and workflow within development teams.

- 1+ years of experience leading SaaS product development and operations.
- 1+ years of experience applying AI to improve productivity, delivery efficiency, or decision making.

- Able to create strong relationships and gain trust within your team.
